timing_labels.report_wall_clock_s: Recovery-invocation timed interval: t_start is after argument parsing/optional match-run config, before seeding, fresh run creation, source snapshot, data/scaler setup, model initialization and W&B initialization. Stops when final report dict is constructed, before writing that JSON and before wandb.finish(). Includes restore, renderer warmup, optimization, validation and checkpoint/HF upload work within that invocation; excludes earlier original training, interruption downtime, imports/argument parsing and the final W&B flush.
timing_labels.it_per_s: (step - initial_step)/(now - t0). t0 is set immediately before restoring optimizer/history; includes restoration and subsequent warmup, optimization, validation and uploads, but excludes earlier recovery setup. It is a cumulative recovered-segment rate, not full-run throughput; do not sum or average across runs to reconstruct runtime.
timing_labels.original_workflow_status: Historical original state still says running; stale lifecycle record, not evidence of a live original worker. Preserve unchanged.
timing_labels.final_elapsed_span_formula: Final successful recovery S2 attempt finished_unix minus 1790439893.0631018.
timing_labels.final_elapsed_span_label: Original-start to recovery-finish elapsed span, including original work, interruption/downtime, recovery setup and repeated work; not uninterrupted training time or GPU compute time.
timing_labels.repeated_update_basis: Parent-observed original log reached 174400; recovery resumes atomic step172000. This lower bound was supplied by parent and not independently reconstructed in this bounded logging check.
